refnamediv.refpurpose: Remove a filter from a stream

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
boolstream_filter_remove resourcestream_filter
Removes a stream filter previously added to a stream with stream_filter_prepend or stream_filter_append. Any data remaining in the filter's internal buffer will be flushed through to the next filter before removing it. On a write chain the flushed data is written to the stream, on a read chain it is added to the read buffer, and the filters after it receive it as normal data. Data already in the read buffer stays filtered.
With STREAM_FILTER_ALL (or the default mode on a r+ or w+ stream), stream_filter_append and stream_filter_prepend return the write chain instance only: removing it leaves the read chain filter in place, and it cannot be removed before the stream is closed.

&reftitle.returnvalues;
&return.success; &false; is only returned with an E_WARNING: when called from the chain of the filter itself (Cannot remove filter while it is being applied), or when the final flush fails (the filter then stays attached). After a successful call the filter resource is closed.
